title: [DEV] DASH: Driver hangs at handshaking for a long time (5mins +)
body:
Build: personal branch based on https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/2549
Pump: Dash
Time: 01:23:23.260
Logs: [AndroidAPS_LOG_1684713297602.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/11534685/AndroidAPS_LOG_1684713297602.log.zip)

The driver kept on handshaking for a long time. 

I believe this is caused by a race condition because the driver already states it's disconnected while the actual disconnecting still has to happen. See logs at given timestamp

Fix is being tested and can be found here: https://github.com/jbr7rr/AndroidAPS/tree/dash-fix-race-condition-on-disconnect
Will make PR after testing
